_about: U38 (the owner, 29 Oct 2026: a game in the background ignores pad input, as is standard): one focus gate for flight and menus, focus_only the opt-out for both, a button held across the return ignored until released; U30's hand-back: the rumble help names only what is sent (the autopilot's hand-back pulse).

focus_only.help: Ignore the controller while the game is in the background, in flight and in menus. A button held when you come back is ignored until you release it.

rumble.help: Vibration strength for the autopilot's hand-back pulse (the only vibration so far). 0 = off. Never the only cue; silent while the game is in the background.
